title: Shrimp and Pilaf Casserole
description: A flavorful and healthy casserole made with succulent shrimp and a nutty pilaf, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the pilaf according to package instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Stir in the lemon juice and season with salt-free seasoning.
Combine the cooked pilaf and shrimp mixture in a large bowl.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with chopped parsley and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until heated through.
